question: Is the Aurzen TravelPlay a good back seat screen for a Tesla Model Y? Where can I buy one?
query: Aurzen TravelPlay review Tesla Model Y compatibility where to buy

replays.text:
**It could be a good fit if you have a 2025–2026 Model Y Refresh and want a movie screen for use while parked.** The TravelPlay is a custom-fit screen that also works as a sunshade, with rear-seat, tailgate, and panoramic-roof viewing modes. It clips in without tools and folds away for storage. [Aurzen describes the product and fitment here](https://aurzen.com/collections/new-releases/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y).

A couple of caveats: it’s **just the screen, not a projector**, so you’ll need a compatible portable projector too. It’s for parked viewing, not watching while driving. And Aurzen says it’s designed for the 2025–2026 refresh; a deal listing notes the rear panel may not fully cover the window on 2020–2024 Model Ys. [Source](https://dealectric.com/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-tesla-model-y)

**Where to buy:** Direct from [Aurzen’s U.S. store](https://aurzen.com/collections/new-releases/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y). It’s listed at **$119.99** (regularly $129.99); Aurzen says the product is available in the U.S. only.
